name: loneliness
description: Sadness from lack of significant social contact.

variations.name: lonely in a crowd
variations.description: Even surrounded by others, you can be saddened by the lack of a specific type of social interaction.

variations.name: isolation loneliness
variations.description: If you've been by yourself for an extended period, you may perceive most any social contact as significant.

conditions: You perceive that the social situation is not living up to what's desired.
